description: We are LOS DEL ESPACIO, building Cocha Digital Twin AI for Cochabamba: reproducible Earth-system evidence from NASA Landsat (LST, NDVI, QA) to detect urban heat and vegetation trends. Skills: software, geospatial data, web/API, analysis. Looking for teammates in Earth science, data viz, ML, and science communication. Join us to turn satellite observations into clear, local insights for the Trend Detective challenge.
